rows.56:16a0:
She was in love with whoever used this shoe locker.
At one time, her heartfelt letters and presents were quietly left somewhere in these shoe lockers...
But sadly, her feelings never reached that person.
Unable to bear her grief, the girl killed herself...
Even so, her love didn't fade, and she stays on as a spirit in this place, the only place she ever entrusted her feelings to...
What a sad fate.
{b}, don't you think so?
What was it she poured her feelings into...?
Don't you want to know?
Maybe it's still hidden away somewhere in these shoe lockers, even now.
Waiting for someone to accept her feelings...
That's it!
For her to be freed from the hold these shoe lockers have on her, someone has to throw them open.
Now, {b}.{p}For her sake, open the shoe locker.
rows.56:1ca8:
"Huh★
W-wait a minute, Kazama?"
I got caught up in it and peeked inside too.
But.........{p}
rows.56:22e0:
"Heeey, {b}!"
...Oh, it was just Kazama coming back.
He could've just stayed away until the meeting was over.
rows.56:2984:
Are you scared?
It's all right, I'm here with you.
If you're nervous, I'll hold your hand for you.
You say you're fine...?
There's no need to be shy about it.
There, now you feel safe, don't you?
Well then, I'll tell my story.{p}
rows.56:2cdc:
It's all right.
You don't have to deny it in such a hurry.
{b}...
You think there aren't any spirits in a place like this.
I can tell the moment I look at your face.{p}
rows.56:3440: Leave Kazama behind and go back first
rows.56:3a70:
"You're the host, aren't you?
Would you hurry up and move on to the next story?
I've had enough of being kept waiting."
...How selfish can a person be?
He won't even open a door himself, yet he says whatever he likes.
I can't believe someone this flaky has a sixth sense.
Who knows how much of that story he just told was even true.
...But still.
I have to keep all of this to myself.
When I was closing the door, I saw it.
A huge crack running through the club room door...
Just how strong is he?
Let sleeping dogs lie.
It's best not to get involved with people like him.
I'm sure everyone else thinks so too.
Okay, let's move on to the next story before he gets angry.{p}
rows.56:3f40:
A nauseating stench stung my nose.
What a horrible smell!
It smelled like a dead crayfish left in a tank for two or three days.
It seemed kind of musty too.
Could this be the source of the aura swirling in the shoe locker?
If so, it was a monstrously vicious aura, full of hatred.
What do I do...
I couldn't stop shaking.
I'd opened something terrible.
That was how it felt.
Kazama was staring into the shoe locker too, as if glaring at it.
And then, slowly, he closed the door...{p}
rows.56:44a0:
Eww!
The soles are crammed with thumbtacks!
Whoever owns these indoor shoes must be really hated.
Or maybe they're being bullied...
I hope it's just someone's prank.
Looking at the rows of thumbtack points, I found myself thinking that the scariest thing of all might be the human heart.
Or else...
Could this be the work of an evil spirit too?
With trembling hands, I closed the shoe locker's door.{p}
